items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: I think he swapped jobs with Gussie Miller. ... Gussie can tell you that. I heard that. Somebody told me that.

ctx.x: I never knew him. He was on bass and piano.

Yeah. And I understand they flopped. And when Larry came back home, my dad said, well, that's the end of it. Just, well, throw that thing away and come to work and forget the music. So Larry said, well, all right. And he went to work with my dad. One afternoon, Tom Brown came to the house. And he said, well, I'm going to go to work with him. So Larry told my dad, he looked out, he said, it's Tom Brown out there. So my dad said, I'll go talk to him. So he went out and he said, Tommy said, now look, Brown, if…
What's that? Gussie Miller was very good.
